# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

seedlings_data <- read_csv(here("data", "theme5_ghg_afolu.csv"))
head(seedlings_data)
```

# Tasks

1. Fit a multiple linear regression model predicting crop `yield_tonnes_ha` based on `fertilizer_nitrogen_kg_ha` and `soil_organic_carbon_pct`.
2. Inspect the model coefficients and R-squared parameters using `summary()`.
3. Draw diagnostic residual plots (`Residuals vs Fitted` and `Normal Q-Q`) to evaluate regression assumptions.

Write your regression modeling code below:

```{r}
# 1. Fit model
model_fit <- lm(yield_tonnes_ha ~ fertilizer_nitrogen_kg_ha + soil_organic_carbon_pct, data = seedlings_data)

# 2. Show coefficients summary
summary(model_fit)

# 3. Plot diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(model_fit, which = 1:2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
